content: godbus/dbus v5 (github.com/godbus/dbus/v5) latest v5.2.2 released 2025-12-29, verified via Go module proxy. BSD-2-Clause, ~1.2k stars, the de-facto standard native Go D-Bus implementation (goroutine-safe connections, signal channels, Export for service-side). Fedora/Guix distros package older 5.1.0 but upstream API is stable across v5.x.
